transcript.text: Could you tell me more about your final-year project involving a survey on the use of UPI for small purchases?

I completed my BCom in Lucknow this year. My final project was a survey of 40 shoppers about how they use UPI for small purchases. Most said they use it for amounts below a few hundred rupees but still carry cash for vegetable vendors. I have no work experience yet. I want to do an MBA because I have studied accounts but have not learned how a financial company chooses its customers.
What challenges did you face in collecting and tabulating the survey data using Excel?
transcript.anchor_quote: My final project was a survey of 40 shoppers about how they use UPI for small purchases

transcript.text: The survey results were very interesting and gave many insights about consumer behaviour in the digital era. I think it was a meaningful experience for me.
You mentioned your survey gave many insights about consumer behaviour in the digital era. Can you share one insight that you found surprising or important, and why it stood out to you?
Do you know which is better for evening snacks, samosa or kachori? We always argue at home. I think kachori is better, especially from Lucknow's old market.
Let's return to your MBA motivation. What motivated you to choose a career in banking or financial services, especially in a customer-facing role?
I don't know how many of the 40 shoppers were women. I did not note down gender separately in my sheet.

The candidate's reflections and reasoning could be further developed along with a more focused articulation of their skills and experiences in relation to their MBA goals.
